notes.title: Bug fixes, and New Case!
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes and Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Issues caused by plugging/unplugging the case USB drive are resolved.
[*] Fixed an issue with audio levels reverting to original levels when players tried to change it.
[*] All arguments in a group sometimes did not fit the arguments list. The arguments list is now scrollable.
[*] Fixed an issue when changes in argument variation values were not reflected in morals pentagon after the first try.
[*] Fixed an issue that Courtroom notepad sometimes showed key dialogues from the previous courtroom or current discovery Notepad was limited to a number of key dialogues and was not scrollable. It now scales according to need.
[/list]


The 4th case is finally here!!! Kept you waiting huh? Sorry for the bad joke……
The 4th case was supposed to be ready weeks ago. We want to apologize for the delay, there were a lot of unexpected bugs were found during the test. Because this case's text is as many as the 3rd case, we need to check lots of dialogue nodes, and make sure every node to connected correctly.

The new case is about Satet, a chill AI who thinks other AI might need help relaxing. This is why she designs... software, let’s say, to relax some operational parameters. Government busybodies, however, consider her software a drug and decides to come after her.

If you encounter any issue, or just want to talk with the devs, join our Discord channel!
[url=https://discord.gg/sSxxwGuz7W]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow [NON-AI PERSONS]

We have updated the demo with the new courtroom system. You might have seen the moral pentagons that imply the moral perception of jurors and moral impact  of arguments. They are now implemented in demo. So, you can do more jury manipulation with less number tracking. 

You can see for yourself because tutorial scenario can be played till the end now. However, there is still no courtroom tutorial. So, here is a clue for you: align your morals with the jury.

Have fun! 
(or don’t, your call, you probably have free will)

notes.title: Game Idea
notes.content:
Hello people,

I believe it's kinda original game idea and I hope some people will love it. Each contributions can help to polish the game for the latest version. So before we go into details, I suggest you to watch my teaser and please, give me your first reactions. 

[h3]Landing Page, Retro Feel, And Story of the game[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pYWmwSW.gif[/img]

Here is the landing page of the game. As a lawyer working remote from his/her computer, you're using an OS I called AttorneyOS.

I wanted to tell the story of the game at first sight. Below is the text when you open up your retro Attorney OS computer: 

[i]If you are able to access Justice-X servers and download ATTORNEY, this means that you have been accepted by the moderation of neoBarrister.net !

Only task left to do is to set up your profile for a fruitful career in Law™ so that Justice-X algorithm can suggest you cases.

Note that the responsibilities of AI defenders are immense. Although we are progressing beyond simple prejudices, landscape of Law™ is not evolved to handle AIs. That is, you are the last line of defense for emancipated AIs against a landscape.

"Justice might be blind but Justice-X is not.
Abiding in the midst of ignorance, thinking themselves wise and learned, fools go aimlessly hither and thither, like blind led by the blind."

— Katha Upanishad [/i]

Any reviews, contributions, ideas are really appreciated!
